name: Documentation Portal
tagline: A docs site: a deep page tree, assembled by the application.
realWorld: Nested documentation pages under a few spaces, navigated by tree and by search. The engine has no tree query, so every page load reads a flat list and the hierarchy is built in the app: this profile measures that read.

traffic.desc: every page in a space, which is what building the navigation tree costs

_note: Load-test manifest for this example. The content types are NOT listed here: perf/export-profiles.mjs reads them from the running engine so they cannot drift from the app. This file declares only what the app itself does not: benchmark-scale seed volumes, the arrival rate, the thresholds, and the weighted request mix.
